     1: /* =========================================================
     2:    getFittingReplacementDetailData.ts
     3:    恒永达官网｜接头替代查询详情页数据服务层
     4: 
     5:    文件路径：
     6:    services/resources/getFittingReplacementDetailData.ts
     7: 
     8:    作用：
     9:    1. 根据商品编码读取单个接头替代详情
    10:    2. 当前阶段默认读取：
    11:       fittings / quick-connect / q20
    12:    3. 产品数据来自 q20.zh.ts
    13:    4. 详情页多语言文案来自 q20.detail.intl.ts
    14:    5. 支持 zh / en / es / fr / ko / ru 多语言详情页文案
    15:    6. 后期接后台 / 数据库时，优先改这个文件
    16: ========================================================= */
    17: 
    18: import { fittingReplacementQuickConnectQ20ZhData } from "@/data/resources/fitting-replacement/fittings/quick-connect/q20/q20.zh";
    19: 
    20: import { getFittingReplacementQuickConnectQ20DetailIntl } from "@/data/resources/fitting-replacement/fittings/quick-connect/q20/q20.detail.intl";
    21: 
    22: import type {
    23:   FittingModelRule,
    24:   FittingReplacementProduct,
    25: } from "@/data/resources/fitting-replacement/fitting-replacement.types";
    26: 
    27: import type { FittingReplacementSeriesKey } from "@/data/resources/fitting-replacement/fitting-replacement-series.config";
    28: 
    29: /* =========================================================
    30:    详情页多语言文案类型
    31: ========================================================= */
    32: type FittingReplacementDetailText = ReturnType<
    33:   typeof getFittingReplacementQuickConnectQ20DetailIntl
    34: >;
    35: 
    36: /* =========================================================
    37:    详情页数据类型
    38: ========================================================= */
    39: export interface FittingReplacementDetailPageData {
    40:   /* 当前商品数据 */
    41:   product: FittingReplacementProduct;
    42: 
    43:   /* 型号解析规则 */
    44:   modelRules: FittingModelRule[];
    45: 
    46:   /* 面包屑 */
    47:   breadcrumbs: {
    48:     label: string;
    49:     href?: string;
    50:   }[];
    51: 
    52:   /* 详情页多语言文案 */
    53:   detailText: FittingReplacementDetailText;
    54: }
    55: 
    56: /* =========================================================
    57:    静态数据源类型
    58: 
    59:    说明：
    60:    1. pageData：当前系列产品数据与型号规则
    61:    2. 详情页文案不放在这里
    62:    3. 详情页文案统一从 q20.detail.intl.ts 按 locale 读取
    63: ========================================================= */
    64: interface FittingReplacementStaticDataSource {
    65:   pageData: typeof fittingReplacementQuickConnectQ20ZhData;
    66: }
    67: 
    68: /* =========================================================
    69:    当前支持的详情页数据源映射
    70: 
    71:    当前：
    72:    q20 = fittings / quick-connect / q20
    73: 
    74:    后续：
    75:    q40       = fittings / quick-connect / q40
    76:    hardTube  = fittings / hard-tube
    77:    barbed    = fittings / barbed
    78: ========================================================= */
    79: const FITTING_REPLACEMENT_STATIC_DATA_SOURCE_MAP: Record<
    80:   FittingReplacementSeriesKey,
    81:   FittingReplacementStaticDataSource
    82: > = {
    83:   q20: {
    84:     pageData: fittingReplacementQuickConnectQ20ZhData,
    85:   },
    86: };
    87: 
    88: /* =========================================================
    89:    统一处理编码
    90: ========================================================= */
    91: function normalizeValue(value: string) {
    92:   return value.trim().toUpperCase();
    93: }
    94: 
    95: /* =========================================================
    96:    获取当前系列的数据源
    97: ========================================================= */
    98: function getFittingReplacementStaticDataSource(
    99:   seriesKey: FittingReplacementSeriesKey = "q20"
   100: ) {
   101:   return FITTING_REPLACEMENT_STATIC_DATA_SOURCE_MAP[seriesKey];
   102: }
   103: 
   104: /* =========================================================
   105:    根据商品编码查找产品
   106: 
   107:    说明：
   108:    1. 只在当前 seriesKey 对应的数据源里查找
   109:    2. 不跨系列查找，避免后续不同系列商品编码或型号逻辑混乱
   110: ========================================================= */
   111: function findFittingReplacementProductByCode(
   112:   productCode: string,
   113:   products: FittingReplacementProduct[]
   114: ) {
   115:   const decodedProductCode = decodeURIComponent(productCode);
   116:   const targetCode = normalizeValue(decodedProductCode);
   117: 
   118:   return (
   119:     products.find((item) => {
   120:       return normalizeValue(item.productCode) === targetCode;
   121:     }) || null
   122:   );
   123: }
   124: 
   125: /* =========================================================
   126:    生成详情页面包屑
   127: 
   128:    说明：
   129:    1. 基础层级来自 q20.detail.intl.ts
   130:    2. 最后一项当前产品型号由 service 自动补上
   131:    3. 这样不会污染自动生成的产品数据文件
   132: ========================================================= */
   133: function createDetailBreadcrumbs(
   134:   product: FittingReplacementProduct,
   135:   detailText: FittingReplacementDetailText
   136: ): FittingReplacementDetailPageData["breadcrumbs"] {
   137:   const baseBreadcrumbs = detailText.breadcrumbs.map((item) => {
   138:     return {
   139:       label: String(item.label),
   140:       href: item.href,
   141:     };
   142:   });
   143: 
   144:   return [
   145:     ...baseBreadcrumbs,
   146:     {
   147:       label: product.foreachModel,
   148:     },
   149:   ];
   150: }
   151: 
   152: /* =========================================================
   153:    根据商品编码获取详情页数据
   154: 
   155:    参数说明：
   156:    1. productCode：商品编码，例如 839085
   157:    2. seriesKey：接头系列，当前默认 q20
   158:    3. locale：语言，中文传 zh，外语传 en / es / fr / ko / ru
   159: ========================================================= */
   160: export async function getFittingReplacementDetailData(
   161:   productCode: string,
   162:   seriesKey: FittingReplacementSeriesKey = "q20",
   163:   locale: string = "zh"
   164: ): Promise<FittingReplacementDetailPageData | null> {
   165:   const dataSource = getFittingReplacementStaticDataSource(seriesKey);
   166:   const detailText = getFittingReplacementQuickConnectQ20DetailIntl(locale);
   167: 
   168:   const product = findFittingReplacementProductByCode(
   169:     productCode,
   170:     dataSource.pageData.products
   171:   );
   172: 
   173:   if (!product) {
   174:     return null;
   175:   }
   176: 
   177:   return {
   178:     product,
   179:     modelRules: [...dataSource.pageData.modelRules],
   180:     breadcrumbs: createDetailBreadcrumbs(product, detailText),
   181:     detailText,
   182:   };
   183: }
   184: 
   185: /* =========================================================
   186:    静态导出路径
   187: 
   188:    说明：
   189:    1. 当前路由结构是：
   190:       /resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement/q20/[productCode]
   191:    2. 所以这里仍然只返回 productCode
   192:    3. 后续如果路由升级为 /[seriesKey]/[productCode]
   193:       再改成返回 seriesKey + productCode
   194: ========================================================= */
   195: export function getFittingReplacementDetailStaticParams(
   196:   seriesKey: FittingReplacementSeriesKey = "q20"
   197: ) {
   198:   const dataSource = getFittingReplacementStaticDataSource(seriesKey);
   199: 
   200:   return dataSource.pageData.products.map((product) => {
   201:     return {
   202:       productCode: product.productCode,
   203:     };
   204:   });
   205: }
   206: 
   207: /* =========================================================
   208:    获取当前系列全部产品
   209: ========================================================= */
   210: export function getFittingReplacementProductsBySeries(
   211:   seriesKey: FittingReplacementSeriesKey = "q20"
   212: ) {
   213:   const dataSource = getFittingReplacementStaticDataSource(seriesKey);
   214: 
   215:   return dataSource.pageData.products;
   216: }
   217: 
   218: /* =========================================================
   219:    获取当前系列型号解析规则
   220: ========================================================= */
   221: export function getFittingReplacementModelRulesBySeries(
   222:   seriesKey: FittingReplacementSeriesKey = "q20"
   223: ) {
   224:   const dataSource = getFittingReplacementStaticDataSource(seriesKey);
   225: 
   226:   return dataSource.pageData.modelRules;
   227: }

     1: /* =========================================================
     2:    fitting-replacement-series.config.ts
     3:    恒永达官网｜接头替代查询系列配置
     4: 
     5:    文件路径：
     6:    data/resources/fitting-replacement/fitting-replacement-series.config.ts
     7: 
     8:    作用：
     9:    1. 统一管理接头替代查询不同系列的基础配置
    10:    2. 避免在 Home / Detail / Guide 组件里到处写死 q20 路径
    11:    3. 为后续 Q40 / Q60 / 其他接头系列做模板
    12:    4. 支持中文路径和多语言路径
    13:    5. 解决外语页面点击详情后跳回中文详情页的问题
    14: 
    15:    当前支持：
    16:    1. Q20 快插接头
    17: 
    18:    后续扩展示例：
    19:    q40: {
    20:      seriesKey: "q40",
    21:      seriesCode: "Q40",
    22:      productName: "Q40 快插接头",
    23:      ...
    24:    }
    25: ========================================================= */
    26: 
    27: export type FittingReplacementSeriesKey = "q20";
    28: 
    29: /* =========================================================
    30:    接头系列配置类型
    31: 
    32:    字段说明：
    33:    1. seriesKey：用于 URL 路径，例如 q20
    34:    2. seriesCode：用于显示系列，例如 Q20
    35:    3. productName：用于清单和卡片展示
    36:    4. sourceType：用于全局选型清单区分来源
    37:    5. sourceLabel：用于全局选型清单显示来源名称
    38:    6. homeHref：中文接头替代查询首页路径
    39:    7. detailBaseHref：中文当前系列详情页基础路径
    40:    8. drawingBaseHref：当前系列 2D 图纸 PDF 文件夹路径
    41: ========================================================= */
    42: export interface FittingReplacementSeriesConfig {
    43:   seriesKey: FittingReplacementSeriesKey;
    44:   seriesCode: string;
    45:   productName: string;
    46:   sourceType: "fitting-replacement";
    47:   sourceLabel: string;
    48:   homeHref: string;
    49:   detailBaseHref: string;
    50:   drawingBaseHref: string;
    51: }
    52: 
    53: /* =========================================================
    54:    Q20 系列配置
    55: 
    56:    注意：
    57:    1. 中文默认路径不加 /zh-CN
    58:    2. 外语路径在 getFittingReplacementDetailHref 中动态加前缀
    59:    3. public 目录下文件引用时，不需要写 public
    60: ========================================================= */
    61: export const Q20_FITTING_REPLACEMENT_SERIES_CONFIG: FittingReplacementSeriesConfig =
    62:   {
    63:     seriesKey: "q20",
    64:     seriesCode: "Q20",
    65:     productName: "接头产品",
    66:     sourceType: "fitting-replacement",
    67:     sourceLabel: "接头兼容型号查询",
    68:     homeHref: "/resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement",
    69:     detailBaseHref: "/resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement/q20",
    70:     drawingBaseHref:
    71:       "/downloads/resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement/q20/drawings",
    72:   };
    73: 
    74: /* =========================================================
    75:    系列配置集合
    76: 
    77:    说明：
    78:    后续新增 q40 / q60 时，在这里继续补。
    79: ========================================================= */
    80: export const FITTING_REPLACEMENT_SERIES_CONFIG_MAP: Record<
    81:   FittingReplacementSeriesKey,
    82:   FittingReplacementSeriesConfig
    83: > = {
    84:   q20: Q20_FITTING_REPLACEMENT_SERIES_CONFIG,
    85: };
    86: 
    87: /* =========================================================
    88:    获取系列配置
    89: 
    90:    说明：
    91:    1. 当前默认返回 Q20
    92:    2. 后续如果详情页路由扩展为 /[seriesKey]/[productCode]
    93:       可以根据 seriesKey 动态读取
    94: ========================================================= */
    95: export function getFittingReplacementSeriesConfig(
    96:   seriesKey: FittingReplacementSeriesKey = "q20"
    97: ) {
    98:   return FITTING_REPLACEMENT_SERIES_CONFIG_MAP[seriesKey];
    99: }
   100: 
   101: /* =========================================================
   102:    生成语言前缀
   103: 
   104:    说明：
   105:    1. 中文页面不加语言前缀
   106:    2. 外语页面加 /en /es /fr /ko /ru
   107:    3. 避免外语页面点击详情后跳回中文路径
   108: ========================================================= */
   109: function getLocalePathPrefix(locale: string = "zh") {
   110:   if (!locale || locale === "zh" || locale === "zh-CN") {
   111:     return "";
   112:   }
   113: 
   114:   return `/${locale}`;
   115: }
   116: 
   117: /* =========================================================
   118:    生成接头替代查询首页路径
   119: 
   120:    示例：
   121:    中文：/resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement
   122:    英文：/en/resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement
   123: ========================================================= */
   124: export function getFittingReplacementHomeHref(
   125:   seriesKey: FittingReplacementSeriesKey = "q20",
   126:   locale: string = "zh"
   127: ) {
   128:   const config = getFittingReplacementSeriesConfig(seriesKey);
   129:   const localePrefix = getLocalePathPrefix(locale);
   130: 
   131:   return `${localePrefix}${config.homeHref}`;
   132: }
   133: 
   134: /* =========================================================
   135:    生成详情页路径
   136: 
   137:    示例：
   138:    中文：
   139:    /resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement/q20/839041
   140: 
   141:    英文：
   142:    /en/resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement/q20/839041
   143: 
   144:    说明：
   145:    1. locale 默认是 zh，兼容旧调用
   146:    2. 外语首页 / 选型指引进入详情页时，需要传入当前 locale
   147: ========================================================= */
   148: export function getFittingReplacementDetailHref(
   149:   productCode: string,
   150:   seriesKey: FittingReplacementSeriesKey = "q20",
   151:   locale: string = "zh"
   152: ) {
   153:   const config = getFittingReplacementSeriesConfig(seriesKey);
   154:   const localePrefix = getLocalePathPrefix(locale);
   155: 
   156:   return `${localePrefix}${config.detailBaseHref}/${encodeURIComponent(
   157:     productCode
   158:   )}`;
   159: }
   160: 
   161: /* =========================================================
   162:    生成 2D 图纸 PDF 路径
   163: 
   164:    说明：
   165:    1. PDF 是 public 静态资源
   166:    2. 不需要加语言前缀
   167:    3. 中文和外语详情页共用同一份图纸文件
   168: ========================================================= */
   169: export function getFittingReplacementDrawingPdfHref(
   170:   foreachModel: string,
   171:   seriesKey: FittingReplacementSeriesKey = "q20"
   172: ) {
   173:   const config = getFittingReplacementSeriesConfig(seriesKey);
   174: 
   175:   return `${config.drawingBaseHref}/${foreachModel}.pdf`;
   176: }

     1: /* =========================================================

     9:    1. 统一约束接头替代查询模块的数据结构
    10:    2. 防止商品编码、型号、兼容型号、图片路径、图纸路径等字段写乱
    11:    3. 当前服务：
    12:       - Q20 快插接头替代查询
    13:       - 中文页面 /resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement
    14:       - 多语言页面 /en/resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement 等
    15:    4. 后续 Q40 / Q60 / 硬管接头 / 倒刺接头 / 鲁尔接头扩展时继续复用
    16:    5. 后续从 Excel / 后台 / 数据库导入时，也尽量保持同一套字段
    17: ========================================================= */
    18: 
    19: /* =========================================================
    20:    多语言文本
    21: 
    22:    说明：
    23:    1. 型号解析规则会服务中文、英文、西语、法语、韩语、俄语
    24:    2. zh 为主语言
    25:    3. 其他语言如果暂时没有，可以不填
    26: ========================================================= */
    27: export interface FittingReplacementI18nText {
    28:   zh: string; // 中文
    29:   en?: string; // 英文
    30:   es?: string; // 西班牙语
    31:   fr?: string; // 法语
    32:   ko?: string; // 韩语
    33:   ru?: string; // 俄语
    34: }
    35: 
    36: /* =========================================================
    37:    接头型号解析规则
    38: 
    39:    示例：
    40:    Q2001-PMV-SPPE
    41:    可以拆成：
    42:    Q20 | 01 | P | M | V | S | PP | E
    43: 
    44:    注意：
    45:    1. 同一个代码在不同位置可能含义不同
    46:    2. 例如 S 在“公母端”里表示母端
    47:    3. S 在“形状”里表示直通
    48:    4. 所以必须通过 fieldKey / fieldName 来判断含义
    49:    5. 不能只看代码本身
    50: ========================================================= */
    51: export interface FittingModelRule {
    52:   /* 适用系列，例如 Q20 */
    53:   series: string;
    54: 
    55:   /* 字段顺序，用于前台展示排序 */
    56:   fieldOrder: number;
    57: 
    58:   /* 字段唯一标识，代码里使用，建议英文小写 */
    59:   fieldKey:
    60:   | "series"
    61:   | "tubeOrThread"
    62:   | "gender"
    63:   | "panelMount"
    64:   | "valved"
    65:   | "shape"
    66:   | "housingMaterial"
    67:   | "sealingRingMaterial";
    68: 
    69:   /* 字段名称，例如：管尺寸或螺纹、公母端、是否带阀 */
    70:   fieldName: FittingReplacementI18nText;
    71: 
    72:   /* 取值位置说明，例如：第2段第1位、第3段中间字符 */
    73:   positionDescription: string;
    74: 
    75:   /* 代码，例如 Q20、01、P、M、V、S、PP、E */
    76:   code: string;
    77: 
    78:   /* 代码含义，例如：公端、穿板、EPDM */
    79:   meaning: FittingReplacementI18nText;
    80: }
    81: 
    82: /* =========================================================
    83:    接头替代查询产品数据
    84: 
    85:    说明：
    86:    1. 商品编码是内部唯一 ID
    87:    2. 型号用于解析产品含义
    88:    3. 兼容型号用于客户搜索
    89:    4. 产品图按型号自动匹配
    90:    5. 2D 图纸 PDF 也按型号自动匹配

    92: export interface FittingReplacementProduct {

   133: export interface ParsedFittingModelField {

    23: function normalizeModel(value: string) {
    24:   return value
    25:     .trim()
    26:     .toUpperCase()
    27:     .replace(/[‐‑‒–—―﹘﹣－]/g, "-")
    28:     .replace(/\s+/g, "");
    29: }
    30: 
    31: function formatTemplate(
    32:   template: string,
    33:   values: Record<string, string | number>
    34: ) {
    35:   return Object.entries(values).reduce((result, [key, value]) => {
    36:     return result.replaceAll(`{${key}}`, String(value));
    37:   }, template);
    38: }
    39: 
    40: function formatCompatibleModelsForCard(models: string[]) {
    41:   if (models.length === 0) return "-";
    42: 
    43:   const firstModels = models.slice(0, 3);
    44:   const suffix = models.length > 3 ? ` +${models.length - 3}` : "";
    45: 
    46:   return `${firstModels.join(" / ")}${suffix}`;
    47: }
    48: 
    49: function getLocaleFromBreadcrumbs(
    50:   breadcrumbs: FittingReplacementPageData["breadcrumbs"]
    51: ) {
    52:   const href = breadcrumbs.find((item) => {
    53:     return /^\/(en|es|fr|ko|ru)(\/|$)/.test(item.href ?? "");
    54:   })?.href;
    55: 
    56:   return href?.split("/")[1] ?? "zh";
    57: }
    58: 
    59: function getLocalizedProductDetailHref(
    60:   href: string | undefined,
    61:   locale: string
    62: ) {
    63:   if (!href) return undefined;
    64: 
    65:   const isChinese = locale === "zh" || locale === "zh-CN";
    66:   const isExternalOrProtocolRelative =
    67:     !href.startsWith("/") || href.startsWith("//");
    68:   const alreadyLocalized = /^\/(en|es|fr|ko|ru)(\/|$)/.test(href);
    69: 
    70:   if (isChinese || isExternalOrProtocolRelative || alreadyLocalized) {
    71:     return href;
    72:   }
    73: 
    74:   return `/${locale}${href}`;
    75: }

    77: const fittingHomeUi: Record<string, { breadcrumb: string; queryLabel: string }> = {
    78:   es: { breadcrumb: "Ruta de navegación", queryLabel: "Modelo consultado: " },
    79:   fr: { breadcrumb: "Fil d’Ariane", queryLabel: "Modèle recherché : " },
    80:   ko: { breadcrumb: "이동 경로", queryLabel: "검색 모델: " },

    84: function findProductsByCompatibleModel(
    85:   products: FittingReplacementProduct[],
    86:   keyword: string
    87: ) {
    88:   const normalizedKeyword = normalizeModel(keyword);
    89: 
    90:   if (!normalizedKeyword) return [];
    91: 
    92:   return products.filter((product) => {
    93:     return product.competitorModels.some((compatibleModel) => {
    94:       return normalizeModel(compatibleModel) === normalizedKeyword;
    95:     });
    96:   });
    97: }

    99: export default function FittingReplacementHome({
   100:   data,

   102:   const [searchValue, setSearchValue] = useState("");
   103:   const [submittedKeyword, setSubmittedKeyword] = useState("");
   104:   const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState(1);
   105: 
   106:   useEffect(() => {
   107:     const compatibleQueryFromUrl = new URLSearchParams(
   108:       window.location.search
   109:     ).get("q")?.trim();
   110: 
   111:     if (!compatibleQueryFromUrl) return;
   112: 
   113:     setSearchValue(compatibleQueryFromUrl);
   114:     setSubmittedKeyword(compatibleQueryFromUrl);
   115:     setCurrentPage(1);
   116:   }, []);
   117: 
   118:   const { addItem, getItem, removeItem } = useSelectionCart();
   119: 
   120:   const homeText = data.homeText;
   121:   const pageLocale = getLocaleFromBreadcrumbs(data.breadcrumbs);
   122:   const localizedUi = fittingHomeUi[pageLocale];
   123: 
   124:   const exampleModels = useMemo(() => {
   125:     const unique = new Map<string, string>();
   126: 
   127:     for (const product of data.products) {
   128:       for (const model of product.competitorModels) {
   129:         const normalized = normalizeModel(model);
   130: 
   131:         if (normalized && !unique.has(normalized)) {
   132:           unique.set(normalized, model);
   133:         }
   134: 
   135:         if (unique.size >= 5) {
   136:           return [...unique.values()];
   137:         }
   138:       }
   139:     }
   140: 
   141:     return [...unique.values()];
   142:   }, [data.products]);
   143: 
   144:   const searchResults = useMemo(() => {
   145:     return findProductsByCompatibleModel(data.products, submittedKeyword);
   146:   }, [data.products, submittedKeyword]);
   147: 
   148:   const visibleProducts = submittedKeyword
   149:     ? searchResults
   150:     : data.products.filter((product) => product.showOnHome);
   151: 
   152:   const totalPages = Math.max(
   153:     1,
   154:     Math.ceil(visibleProducts.length / PAGE_SIZE)

   156:

   158:   const pageStart = (safePage - 1) * PAGE_SIZE;
   159:   const pageEnd = pageStart + PAGE_SIZE;
   160: 
   161:   const paginatedProducts = visibleProducts.slice(pageStart, pageEnd);
   162: 
   163:   function handleSubmitSearch() {
   164:     const keyword = searchValue.trim();
   165:     setSubmittedKeyword(keyword);
   166:     setCurrentPage(1);
   167:   }
   168: 
   169:   function handleExampleSearch(model: string) {
   170:     setSearchValue(model);
   171:     setSubmittedKeyword(model);
   172:     setCurrentPage(1);
   173:   }
   174: 
   175:   function handleOpenDetail(product: FittingReplacementProduct) {

   178:       pageLocale
   179:     );
   180:

   182:

   184:   }
   185: 
   186:   function handleToggleCart(product: FittingReplacementProduct) {

   209:         getLocalizedProductDetailHref(product.detailHref, pageLocale) ??

   397:                             value: product.productCode,
   398:                           },
   399:                           {
   400:                             label:
   401:                               homeText?.productCard.foreachModel ??
   402:                               "FOREACH 型号：",
   403:                             value: product.foreachModel,
   404:                           },
   405:                           {
   406:                             label:
   407:                               homeText?.productCard.compatibleModels ??
   408:                               "兼容型号：",
   409:                             value: formatCompatibleModelsForCard(
   410:                               product.competitorModels
   411:                             ),
   412:                           },
   413:                         ]}
   414:                         actions={actions}
   415:                       />
   416:                     );
   417:                   })}
   418:                 </div>
   419: 
   420:                 {totalPages > 1 ? (
   421:                   <div className="frp-pagination">
   422:                     <button
   423:                       type="button"
   424:                       disabled={safePage <= 1}
   425:                       onClick={() => {
   426:                         setCurrentPage((page) =>
   427:                           Math.max(1, page - 1)
   428:                         );
   429:                       }}
   430:                     >
   431:                       {homeText?.pagination.previous ?? "上一页"}
   432:                     </button>
   433: 
   434:                     <span>
   435:                       {safePage} / {totalPages}
   436:                     </span>
   437: 
   438:                     <button
   439:                       type="button"
   440:                       disabled={safePage >= totalPages}
   441:                       onClick={() => {
   442:                         setCurrentPage((page) =>
   443:                           Math.min(totalPages, page + 1)
   444:                         );
   445:                       }}
   446:                     >
   447:                       {homeText?.pagination.next ?? "下一页"}
   448:                     </button>
   449:                   </div>
   450:                 ) : null}
   451:               </>
   452:             )}
   453:           </div>
   454:         </section>
   455:       </main>
   456:     </div>
   457:   );
   458: }
   459:

    60: /* =========================================================
    61:    从面包屑判断当前语言
    62: 
    63:    说明：
    64:    1. 中文页面 href 通常是 /
    65:    2. 外语页面 href 通常是 /en、/fr 等
    66:    3. 这里只服务详情页型号解析字段的多语言展示
    67: ========================================================= */
    68: function getLocaleFromBreadcrumbs(
    69:   breadcrumbs: FittingReplacementDetailPageData["breadcrumbs"]
    70: ): FittingReplacementLocale {
    71:   const localeHref = breadcrumbs.find((item) => {
    72:     return (
    73:       item.href?.startsWith("/en") ||
    74:       item.href?.startsWith("/es") ||
    75:       item.href?.startsWith("/fr") ||
    76:       item.href?.startsWith("/ko") ||
    77:       item.href?.startsWith("/ru")
    78:     );
    79:   })?.href;
    80: 
    81:   if (localeHref?.startsWith("/en")) return "en";
    82:   if (localeHref?.startsWith("/es")) return "es";
    83:   if (localeHref?.startsWith("/fr")) return "fr";
    84:   if (localeHref?.startsWith("/ko")) return "ko";
    85:   if (localeHref?.startsWith("/ru")) return "ru";
    86: 
    87:   return "zh";
    88: }
    89: 
    90: /* =========================================================
    91:    读取多语言文本
    92: 
    93:    说明：
    94:    1. 优先当前语言
    95:    2. 其次英文
    96:    3. 最后中文
    97: ========================================================= */
    98: function getLocalizedText(
    99:   text: FittingReplacementI18nText | undefined,
   100:   locale: FittingReplacementLocale
   101: ) {
   102:   if (!text) return "-";
   103: 
   104:   return text[locale] || text.en || text.zh || "-";
   105: }
   106: 
   107: const fittingDetailBreadcrumbLabels: Partial<Record<FittingReplacementLocale, string>> = {
   108:   es: "Ruta de navegación",

   111:   ru: "Навигационная цепочка",

   130:

   140: export default function FittingReplacementDetail({
   141:   data,
   142: }: FittingReplacementDetailProps) {
   143:   const { product, modelRules, breadcrumbs, detailText } = data;
   144: 
   145:   const { addItem, getItem, removeItem, toggleDrawingNeed } = useSelectionCart();
   146: 
   147:   const locale = useMemo(() => {
   148:     return getLocaleFromBreadcrumbs(breadcrumbs);
   149:   }, [breadcrumbs]);
   150: 
   151:   /* 当前型号对应的 2D PDF 图纸路径 */
   152:   const drawingPdfHref = getFittingReplacementDrawingPdfHref(
   153:     product.foreachModel,
   154:     SERIES_CONFIG.seriesKey
   155:   );
   156:

   159: 
   160:   /* =========================================================
   161:      面包屑显示层清理
   162: 
   163:      说明：
   164:      1. 详情页面包屑已由 service 根据 locale 生成
   165:      2. 这里只做兼容性过滤

   167:   const normalizedBreadcrumbs = useMemo(() => {
   168:     return breadcrumbs.filter((item) => {
   169:       return item.label !== "选型支持";

   172: 
   173:   /* 当前产品在全局清单中的状态 */

   180:

   183:     return parseFittingModelWithRules(product.foreachModel, modelRules);
   184:   }, [product.foreachModel, modelRules]);
   185: 
   186:   function getParsedField(fieldKey: FittingModelRule["fieldKey"]) {
   187:     return getParsedFittingField(parsedFields, fieldKey);
   188:   }
   189: 
   190:   const compactRows: Array<
   191:     [FittingModelRule["fieldKey"], FittingModelRule["fieldKey"] | null]
   192:   > = [
   193:       ["tubeOrThread", "gender"],
   194:       ["panelMount", "valved"],
   195:       ["shape", "housingMaterial"],
   196:       ["sealingRingMaterial", null],
   197:     ];
   198: 
   199:   /* =========================================================
   200:      生成当前产品写入清单的数据
   201:

   203:      1. 避免“加入清单”和“添加图纸”两处重复写一大段
   204:      2. needDrawing 由按钮行为决定
   205:   ========================================================= */
   206:   function createCurrentProductCartItem(needDrawing: boolean) {
   207:     return {
   208:       sourceType: SERIES_CONFIG.sourceType,
   209:       sourceLabel: SERIES_CONFIG.sourceLabel,
   210:       productName: SERIES_CONFIG.productName,
   211:       productCode: product.productCode,
   212:       foreachModel: product.foreachModel,
   213:       competitorModels: product.competitorModels,
   214:       quantity: 1,
   215:       needDrawing,
   216:       imagePath: product.imagePath,
   217:       detailHref: getFittingReplacementDetailHref(
   218:         product.productCode,
   219:         SERIES_CONFIG.seriesKey,
   220:         locale
   221:       ),
   222:     };
   223:   }
   224: 
   225:   /* =========================================================
   226:      切换当前产品清单状态
   227: 
   228:      说明：
   229:      1. 未加入清单时，点击加入清单
   230:      2. 已加入清单时，点击取消加入清单
   231:      3. 如果该产品已标记需要图纸，取消清单时也会一起移除图纸需求
   232:   ========================================================= */
   233:   function handleToggleCart() {
   234:     if (currentCartItem) {
   235:       removeItem(currentCartItem.id);
   236:       return;
   237:     }
   238: 
   239:     addItem(createCurrentProductCartItem(false));
   240:   }
   241: 
   242:   function handleToggleCurrentProductDrawingNeed() {
   243:     if (currentCartItem) {
   244:       toggleDrawingNeed(currentCartItem.id, !currentProductNeedDrawing);
   245:       return;
   246:     }
   247: 
   248:     addItem(createCurrentProductCartItem(true));
   249:   }
   250: 
   251:   return (
   252:     <div className="fitting-replacement-detail-page">
   253:       <main className="frd-main">
   254:         <div className="frd-container">

   257:             ariaLabel={

   259:               (locale === "zh" ? "面包屑导航" : "Breadcrumb")
   260:             }
   261:           />
   262: 
   263:           <section className="frd-detail-section">
   264:             <div className="frd-detail-layout">
   265:               <div className="frd-product-visual">
   266:                 <img
   267:                   src={product.imagePath}
   268:                   alt={product.foreachModel}
   269:                   onError={(event) => {
   270:                     event.currentTarget.style.display = "none";
   271:                   }}
   272:                 />
   273:               </div>
   274: 
   275:               <div className="frd-info-area">
   276:                 <div className="frd-title-block">
   277:                   <h2>{product.foreachModel}</h2>
   278:                 </div>
   279: 
   280:                 <table className="frd-compact-table">
   281:                   <tbody>
   282:                     <tr className="frd-head-row">
   283:                       <td className="frd-label">
   284:                         {detailText.tableLabels.productCode}
   285:                       </td>
   286:                       <td className="frd-value" colSpan={3}>
   287:                         {product.productCode}
   288:                       </td>
   289:                     </tr>
   290: 
   291:                     <tr>
   292:                       <td className="frd-label">
   293:                         {detailText.tableLabels.compatibleModels}
   294:                       </td>
   295:                       <td className="frd-value" colSpan={3}>
   296:                         {product.competitorModels.join(" / ") || "-"}
   297:                       </td>
   298:                     </tr>
   299: 
   300:                     {compactRows.map(([leftKey, rightKey]) => {
   301:                       const leftField = getParsedField(leftKey);
   302:                       const rightField = rightKey
   303:                         ? getParsedField(rightKey)
   304:                         : null;
   305: 
   306:                       return (
   307:                         <tr key={`${leftKey}-${rightKey || "empty"}`}>
   308:                           <td className="frd-label">
   309:                             {getLocalizedFieldName(leftField, locale)}
   310:                           </td>
   311: 
   312:                           <td className="frd-value">
   313:                             {getLocalizedText(leftField?.meaning, locale)}
   314:                           </td>
   315: 
   316:                           {rightField ? (
   317:                             <>
   318:                               <td className="frd-label">
   319:                                 {getLocalizedFieldName(rightField, locale)}
   320:                               </td>
   321: 
   322:                               <td className="frd-value">
   323:                                 {getLocalizedText(rightField.meaning, locale)}
   324:                               </td>
   325:                             </>
   326:                           ) : (
   327:                             <td className="frd-empty" colSpan={2} />
   328:                           )}
   329:                         </tr>
   330:                       );
   331:                     })}
   332:                   </tbody>
   333:                 </table>
   334:

   339:                         ? "frd-add-button is-added"
   340:                         : "frd-add-button"
   341:                     }
   342:                     type="button"
   343:                     onClick={handleToggleCart}
   344:                   >
   345:                     {currentCartItem
   346:                       ? detailText.actions.addedToCart
   347:                       : detailText.actions.addToCart}
   348:                   </button>
   349: 
   350:                   <button
   351:                     className={
   352:                       currentProductNeedDrawing
   353:                         ? "frd-drawing-toggle-button is-active"
   354:                         : "frd-drawing-toggle-button"
   355:                     }
   356:                     type="button"
   357:                     onClick={handleToggleCurrentProductDrawingNeed}
   358:                   >
   359:                     {currentProductNeedDrawing
   360:                       ? detailText.actions.addedDrawing
   361:                       : detailText.actions.addDrawing}
   362:                   </button>
   363:                 </div>
   364:               </div>
   365:             </div>
   366:           </section>
   367:

   370:             productModel={product.foreachModel}
   371:             text={detailText.drawingPreview}
   372:           />
   373:

   375:         </div>
   376:       </main>
   377:     </div>
   378:   );

    70: function cleanText(
    71:   value: unknown
    72: ) {
    73:   return String(
    74:     value ?? ""
    75:   ).trim();
    76: }
    77: 
    78: function uniqueValues(
    79:   values: unknown[]
    80: ) {
    81:   return Array.from(
    82:     new Set(
    83:       values
    84:         .map(cleanText)
    85:         .filter(Boolean)
    86:     )
    87:   );

    90: function normalizeConnection(
    91:   value: unknown
    92: ) {
    93:   const text =
    94:     cleanText(value);
    95: 
    96:   const metricMatch =
    97:     text.match(
    98:       /[（(]\s*(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*mm\s*[）)]/i
    99:     );
   100: 
   101:   if (
   102:     metricMatch
   103:   ) {
   104:     return (
   105:       metricMatch[1] +
   106:       " mm"
   107:     );
   108:   }
   109: 
   110:   return text;
   111: }
   112: 
   113: function sortConnections(
   114:   values: string[]
   115: ) {
   116:   return [
   117:     ...values,
   118:   ].sort(
   119:     (
   120:       left,
   121:       right
   122:     ) => {
   123:       const leftMetric =
   124:         left.match(
   125:           /^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*mm$/i
   126:         );
   127: 
   128:       const rightMetric =
   129:         right.match(
   130:           /^(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*mm$/i
   131:         );
   132: 
   133:       if (
   134:         leftMetric &&
   135:         rightMetric
   136:       ) {
   137:         return (
   138:           Number(
   139:             leftMetric[1]
   140:           ) -
   141:           Number(
   142:             rightMetric[1]
   143:           )
   144:         );
   145:       }
   146: 
   147:       if (
   148:         leftMetric
   149:       ) {
   150:         return -1;
   151:       }
   152: 
   153:       if (
   154:         rightMetric
   155:       ) {
   156:         return 1;
   157:       }
   158: 
   159:       return left.localeCompare(
   160:         right,
   161:         "zh-CN"
   162:       );
   163:     }
   164:   );
   165: }
   166: 
   167: function joinValues(
   168:   values: string[]
   169: ) {
   170:   return values.length
   171:     ? values.join("、")
   172:     : "以具体型号为准";
   173: }

   175: function normalizeSeries(
   176:   value: string

   178:   const series =
   179:     cleanText(value)

   182:   if (

   191: }

   722: 
   723: export function getQuickConnectSeriesMetadata(
   724:   seriesInput: string
   725: ) {
   726:   const detail =
   727:     getQuickConnectSeriesDetailData(
   728:       seriesInput
   729:     );
   730: 
   731:   if (
   732:     !detail
   733:   ) {
   734:     return {
   735:       title:
   736:         "快插接头｜FOREACH 恒永达",
   737:     };
   738:   }
   739: 
   740:   return {
   741:     title:
   742:       detail.seo.title,
   743: 
   744:     description:
   745:       detail.seo.description,
   746:   };
   747: }
